title: Modulatory Effects of Jujuboside A on Amino Acid Neurotransmitter Profiles in Tic Disorder.
design: IDPN-induced rat model comparing jujuboside A, tiapride and combination groups with model/normal controls.
original_summary: Abstract reports changes in striatal glutamate/GABA and stereotyped behavior; sample sizes, numerical precision and risk of bias were not extracted. Animal stereotypy is not validated human tic benefit or a treatment recommendation.
retrieval_status: Abstract-only review; no source text retained.
decision: Exclude from new-window count; preserve as historical preclinical context without therapeutic promotion.
